title: CCEP ECoG dataset across age 4-51
description: This dataset contains intracranial electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings of Cortico-Cortical Evoked Potentials (CCEPs) from 74 patients aged 4-51 years, collected during clinical single pulse electrical stimulation (SPES) as part of the RESPect epilepsy surgery patient registry at UMC Utrecht. The data were used to study the developmental trajectory of neural transmission speed across the human lifespan. Electrode positions were localized using Freesurfer with Destrieux atlas labeling and mapped to MNI152 space.
methods_description: CCEPs were measured with ECoG during single pulse electrical stimulation (SPES) in epilepsy surgery patients. Electrode positions were estimated using Freesurfer on individual subject MRI scans, labeled with the Destrieux atlas based on the most common surface label within a sphere around each electrode, then converted to MNI152 space using Freesurfer surface-based non-linear transformation.
